summary: Submitted a repeat of fixed experiment 341e128828854db2a05ee7e8e8a98bf6-experiment, whose harness holds the two-voter probe that bounds the configuration-recovery account: with node A tracking no configuration after its replay-enabled restart, its peer B is restarted so that it must campaign and can only win with A's vote. That boundary result currently rests on a single execution while every other case in both accounts has at least two, so the repeat tests whether the same split comes back from the retained inputs - the peer reaching Leader (which in a two-voter group requires the defective node's vote) and zero candidate samples for the defective node in the sampling window. The rationale states that reproduction question, the repeat consumes one execution, and citing its receipt in the account remains for the next turn if the run allows; otherwise the receipt stands uncited at expiry and the recorded account is unchanged.
